snippet.title: LUCID Gameplay Trailer | Movement, Combat & Exploration
snippet.description:
Movement. Combat. Exploration.

LUCID is a fast-paced action Metroidvania where movement and combat are deeply connected. Strike enemies, chain abilities together, and stay airborne as long as your skill allows.

This gameplay breakdown showcases the core gameplay loop, including movement, combat, exploration, Crystal Arts, Talismans, and the systems that make LUCID unique.
